title: Zelda2mc
description: This resource pack replaces weapons by the official zelda 3D models, converted to minecraft
body:
# Zelda2mc
**Supported versions:** **_1.8-26.3_**
![Master Sword](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e90d2c770f8cb9a9b38fe9f96b372f004fa1a3ee_0.webp)

This resource pack uses highly voxelated converted models, and aims to stay lightweight by not using too many models

## Items list (26.1->26.2+)

<details>
<summary>Vanilla items replacement (Show)</summary>


**Swords**
- Stone Sword    **->** Rusty Broadsword ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62c0f6b6719f424ce160f21e63aa4ffcfe9fbeff.png)
- Copper Sword   **->** Goddess Sword ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c7480353f7b48e1052d847df37da0a9dcdd854c.png)
- Iron Sword     **->** Knight's Broadsword ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62c0f6b6719f424ce160f21e63aa4ffcfe9fbeff.png)
- Golden Sword    **->** Gilded Sword ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7d0223dcdc1cfb8c6acddcf46a14a832d31b65b.png)
- Diamond Sword   **->** Guardian Sword ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62c0f6b6719f424ce160f21e63aa4ffcfe9fbeff.png)
- Netherite Sword **->** Great Sword ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1076c7dc923683c8277b1ee1723208fa0b5282ca_0.webp)
- Wooden Sword **->** Forest Dweller's Sword ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62c0f6b6719f424ce160f21e63aa4ffcfe9fbeff.png) ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16d44e46d9ac5a5fbd86492c63226ba414bc0cda.png)

**Spears**
- Iron Spear **->** Moblin Spear ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae2d48681922705a25a81ba9fe683462667f5ecc.png)
- Netherite Spear **->** Gloom Spear ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16d44e46d9ac5a5fbd86492c63226ba414bc0cda.png)
- Diamond Spear **->** Guardian Spear ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62c0f6b6719f424ce160f21e63aa4ffcfe9fbeff.png)

**Pickaxes**
- Stone Pickaxe **->** Goron Pickaxe ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62c0f6b6719f424ce160f21e63aa4ffcfe9fbeff.png) ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/16d44e46d9ac5a5fbd86492c63226ba414bc0cda.png)
- All the other pickaxes **->** Goron Pickaxe with texture variant

**Shovels**
- Stone Shovel **->** Poacher Saw ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3e35bddceb8e8fb24d009e62b3d664e795882ff_0.webp) ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7d0223dcdc1cfb8c6acddcf46a14a832d31b65b.png)
- All the other shovels **->** Poacher Saw with texture variant

**Others**
- Mace **->** Skull Hammer ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae2d48681922705a25a81ba9fe683462667f5ecc.png)
- Lantern **->** Moblin Lantern ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae2d48681922705a25a81ba9fe683462667f5ecc.png)


</details>

<details>
<summary>CIT support - Only if you use Optifine or CIT Resewn Continuation (Show)</summary>


**CIT (requires Optifine or CIT Resewn Continuation)**
- Netherite Sword **->** Master Sword ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae2d48681922705a25a81ba9fe683462667f5ecc.png)
- Iron Sword **->** Kokiri Sword ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7d0223dcdc1cfb8c6acddcf46a14a832d31b65b.png)
- Iron Sword     **->** Ganon Sword ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ae2d48681922705a25a81ba9fe683462667f5ecc.png)
- Diamond Sword **->** Goddess Sword ![icon](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3c7480353f7b48e1052d847df37da0a9dcdd854c.png)

</details>



<details>
<summary>Exclusive Items obtainable through vanilla commands (Show)</summary>


**Additional Items (Vanilla)**
- Master Sword: 
```
/give @p netherite_sword[custom_name="Master Sword",item_model="minecraft:master_sword"] 1
```

- Ganon Sword: 
```
/give @p iron_sword[custom_name="Ganon Sword",item_model="minecraft:ganon_sword"] 1
```

- Kokiri Sword: 
```
/give @p iron_sword[custom_name="Kokiri Sword",item_model="minecraft:kokiri_sword"] 1
```

- Great Fairy Sword: 
```
/give @p netherite_sword[custom_name="Great Fairy Sword",item_model="minecraft:great_fairy_sword"] 1
```



</details>
